analysis: Post-hoc project sensitivity of frozen primary word-LR LOPO predictions
scope: Evaluation-only exclusions. No model refitting. ActiveMQ remains in original training folds for other projects.

score_definitions.pooled_macro_f1: Macro-F1 over fixed ID/NIO/OD/TD labels; zero for undefined class F1.
score_definitions.mean_present_label_project_f1: Equal-weight mean over retained projects; each project's macro-F1 includes labels present in its ground truth only. This differs from fixed-four-label pooled macro-F1.

conditional_project_bootstrap.sampling_unit: project_group; paired, with replacement; original group count draws
conditional_project_bootstrap.caution: Descriptive conditional intervals from frozen overlapping LOPO fits, not independent retraining or population inference. The four pooled labels remain fixed even when a bootstrap sample lacks a label. No hypothesis test or causal claim.

refitting_interpretation: These scores test the concentration of evaluation outcomes. To claim robustness to removing ActiveMQ from the available training corpus, remove it before fitting and rerun all remaining LOPO folds; that is a separate estimand and was not done here.
